project: Boriyad Youth Academy, Ashewa Meda, Oromia, Ethiopia

crs.note: The geotechnical report states hand-held GPS on UTM Adindan. Its borehole northings fall 36-84 m south of this polygon; the datum basis is unresolved. See docs/02-ground-and-survey-review.md.

model_origin.instruction: Place Rhino world origin (0,0,0) at this easting/northing at reduced level 0.00. Model +X = true East, +Y = true North, +Z = up. All coordinates below are LOCAL (world minus origin).

largest_inscribed_cardinal_rectangle.note: Brute-force result at 1 m resolution. This is the orthogonal build envelope; the residual ~1,150 m2 is a western and southern wedge suited to landscape, drop-off and the agricultural plot.

orientation.finding: The plot is very nearly cardinally aligned. East boundary 1.75 deg off true north-south; north boundary 6.31 deg off true east-west. Building parallel to the boundaries therefore also aligns the long elevations north and south. Do NOT rotate the grid; the site grain and the solar optimum coincide.

roads.east: assumed principal road (Ambo Road corridor) - TO BE CONFIRMED
roads.south: secondary road / junction at the south-west
roads.west: lower-density residential fabric, dense small plots

setbacks_assumed_m.warning: Road reservation NOT yet quantified. Treat as a parameter; re-run if a reservation is imposed.

solar.sun_north_of_zenith: late April to late August (kiremt rains, mostly diffuse)
solar.critical_orientations: East and west. 07:00-09:00 and 15:30-18:00 the sun sits at 10-30 deg altitude. Horizontal shading is ineffective at these angles; use vertical fins.
solar.overheating_design_condition: March to April, end of the long dry season
solar.design_rule: North and south facades: horizontal overhang 1.2 m. East and west facades: vertical fins or a veranda of 2.5-3.0 m.

ground.source: NATM Engineering Plc, October 2024, for Three M JY Trading Plc. Boreholes lie OUTSIDE this polygon - indicative only.

strata.desc: soft to medium stiff dark grey high plastic silty CLAY (black cotton)
stiff to very stiff reddish brown high plastic silty CLAY with sand and gravel
weak to moderately weak highly weathered closely jointed fractured vesicular BASALT

ground.groundwater: none encountered to 10-15 m; surface water only in the rains; site described as swampy and nearly flat
ground.expansive_soil: SEVERE. FW 120-130 pct with PI 45-63 at 1.5-3.0 m. Active zone assumed 2.5-4.0 m.
ground.bearing_note: Report adopts BH-3; BH-2 is weaker. Carry 275 kPa until site-specific boreholes say otherwise.

seismic.note: The report states I = 1.0, which is wrong for a school. Plan regularity matters: avoid re-entrant corners and torsional irregularity; separate volumes with movement joints.

services.sanitation: Waterborne. Art.8.2(13)/8.3(17) specify pits, which cannot stack. On-site packaged treatment (baffled reactor plus planted gravel filter) required; no soakaway is possible in this clay.
services.note: Suspended ground-floor slab everywhere there is no basement. No high-water-demand trees (eucalyptus) within 1.5x mature height of any footing.
